publisher: District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection
ownership: Official Basic Business License records published through Open Data DC and the DCGIS FEEDS/DCRA ArcGIS service
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS ArcGIS query and bulk download access. The catalog identifies DLCP as publisher, public access, and CC BY 4.0 licensing.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata, count, and selected-field ArcGIS queries
deterministic conversion of official MAR Maryland State Plane NAD83 coordinates to WGS84
derived business-registry assertions and source-linked relationships
redistribution of aggregate statistics with source attribution, CC BY 4.0 notice, and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing source status Active as independent proof that a premise is continuously operating, open to the public, solvent, or compliant with every requirement
representing Basic Business Licenses as every business in the District of Columbia or United States because exemptions and other licensing regimes exist
counting multiple business-activity rows for one Customer Number as multiple premises or organizations
representing a premise address or MAR coordinate as independently verified current occupancy
publishing record-level sole-proprietor names or possible residential premises without an approved privacy review
acquiring or publishing owner, agent, billing-address, parcel-lot, or rounded latitude/longitude fields
inferring ownership, parent-company, or cross-source identity without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection, Basic Business Licenses, via Open Data DC/DCGIS; licensed CC BY 4.0.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and governed normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Aggregate counts may be redistributed with DLCP/Open Data DC attribution, CC BY 4.0 notice, exact source refresh, source checksum, and license-scope limitations. Record-level normalized data remains local-review-only due sole-proprietor and possible residential content.
personal_data_handling: Entity names can identify sole proprietors and licensed premises can be residences. The connector excludes owner, agent, billing, parcel-lot, and unusably rounded latitude/longitude fields at query time and keeps selected source and normalized record-level artifacts local.
